newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi registered as NZ bank.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi registered as NZ bank.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Wednesday that Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi (Australia) Ltd has been registered as a bank in New Zealand.
The bank, a subsidiary of the Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi of Japan, was incorporated and domiciled in Australia and would operate in New Zealand as a branch, the RBNZ said in a statement.
The registration brings the number of banks registered in New Zealand to 17.
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi is the first Japanese bank to be registered in New Zealand.
The RB is also processing an application from Deutsche Bank AG, according to industry sources. That application is expected to be announced within a month.
